description: Supported integration patterns. Connector records carry no secrets, grant no permissions and do not imply connections are active.

connectors.notes: Repository metadata, issues and pull requests using scoped tokens; write calls require owner approval
CRM contacts, companies and deals; contact mutations gated
Host and auth details may vary by account; verify current API details before operation
Never use service-role credentials in client code; exact project host requires configuration; use scoped roles where possible
API metadata and bounded operations; native CLI deployment adapter is separate
Read-only mode exclusively. Financial changes require dedicated connector with stronger approval and provider verification
OAuth access token is short-lived; token refresh and delegated permissions require configured OAuth client
